title: What Atmospheric River Forecasting Is
definition: Atmospheric River Forecasting: forecasting rivers in the sky.
description:
Atmospheric River Forecasting is forecasting rivers in the sky. It sits squarely in Future Climate & Planetary Care, the frontier where AR models science becomes forecast logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are flood prep-scale. Societies that master forecast hulls early will shape reservoir ops practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why AR models programs worldwide now treat Atmospheric River Forecasting as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Atmospheric River Forecasting needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Real Research Today: Atmospheric River Forecasting
definition: Today's documented research behind Atmospheric River Forecasting.
description:
The road to Atmospheric River Forecasting is already being paved. Solar geoengineering research (Harvard SCoPEx heritage, Degrees Initiative) studies governance first. The Great Green Wall initiative restores 100M hectares across Africa's Sahel.

Mangrove and seagrass blue-carbon projects earn verified carbon credits. Together these programs form the AR models foundation that Atmospheric River Forecasting will build on — the forecast logistics results, the reservoir ops methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as forecast logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

First governed forecast hulls field trials: forecast logistics monitoring published openly, reservoir ops oversight in place.

title: Readiness Estimator: Atmospheric River Forecasting
definition: Estimates Atmospheric River Forecasting readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Atmospheric River Forecasting components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a forecast hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Atmospheric River Forecasting Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Atmospheric River Forecasting operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Atmospheric River Forecasting installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 64399 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where AR models monitoring, forecast logistics redundancy, or reservoir ops maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Atmospheric River Forecasting Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Atmospheric River Forecasting: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Atmospheric River Forecasting — forecasting rivers in the sky.

Phase 1 — Prove (AR models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (forecast logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (reservoir ops): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (flood prep): forecast hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and West Coast-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
